# GSAP runtime files

Pinned release: GSAP 3.15.1, with the matching ScrollTrigger plugin.
Source commit: 5e6c35ff8eedea12d4f229129def635277d8b0f2.

Sources:
- https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/blob/5e6c35ff8eedea12d4f229129def635277d8b0f2/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/blob/5e6c35ff8eedea12d4f229129def635277d8b0f2/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

The upstream copyright, author and license notices are retained in each file.
GSAP is distributed under its Standard No Charge license:
https://gsap.com/standard-license/

These two local scripts support progressive content reveals. They do not control
the duck, its sounds, the profile pictures, the theme toggle, the contact orbits,
or the CSS sky. No other GSAP plugins are included.
